item.title: Instinct AI Launches Text-Based Assistant With 10 Billion Dollar Valuation
item.description:
Instinct AI Launches Text-Based Assistant With 10 Billion Dollar Valuation

Instinct AI, a startup founded by former Sierra employee Noah Shinn, has launched a new AI agent that operates through a straightforward text message interface. After a quiet release in August that relied on an invite-only model with no marketing, the company was valued at $10 billion in late September, despite mounting pressure from competitors like OpenAI and Meta.

🔍 Overview

Instinct is designed as a consumer-friendly AI agent that handles personal chores and administrative tasks. Unlike many contemporary AI products that use traditional app interfaces or anthropomorphized mascots, Instinct operates entirely through existing messaging channels. The startup focuses on a specific niche that founder Noah Shinn believes sets it apart from larger players building products for a broader range of customers.

🧩 How it works

Instinct functions by providing the AI assistant with access to a virtual machine and personal integrations.

  • Interface: Conversations happen exclusively over text through iMessage, WhatsApp, or email.
  • Integrations: Users can connect the agent to Google Workspace, Slack, and Notion.
  • Security: To log into specific websites, the agent provides a link to a “secure vault” where users enter their credentials.
  • System Access: The agent can plug directly into a user’s personal email and calendar to manage schedules.

⚙️ Key details

The agent is a consumer-oriented version of developer tools like Codex and OpenClaw. It is capable of handling vague instructions and managing various digital tasks:

Task Type Examples of Capabilities
Appointments Booking DMV appointments and emailing doctor’s offices to set up visits.
Communications Sending follow-up emails and handling digital paperwork for Ikea returns.
Research Finding age-appropriate lessons and verifying times and dates for community center classes.

🚀 Availability

Instinct currently lacks a traditional app or a monthly subscription fee. Access is limited through the following methods:

  • An invitation from a current user.
  • Approval from a waitlist.

Because it relies on text messaging, the service is accessible on any device that supports iMessage or WhatsApp, including CarPlay and smartwatches.

💡 Why it matters

The launch of Instinct represents a shift toward autonomous agents for the general public. While the agent has demonstrated some limitations—such as missing specific prerequisite information for class enrollments—its ability to operate across various messaging platforms without a dedicated app separates it from the “cuddly bear” or “blob” mascots used by competitors like Muse and Dots. Shinn remains unfazed by the competition, citing Instinct’s specialized focus as its primary advantage.

#InstinctAI #AIAgents #Startups #OpenAI #NoahShinn

Source: Instinct was the buzziest AI agent around — can it survive Muse?

item.title: Scalekit, Nebius, and Tenki Host Agents and Bagels Event for AI Founders
item.description:
Scalekit, Nebius, and Tenki Host Agents and Bagels Event for AI Founders

Scalekit, Nebius, and Tenki are hosting a special SF Tech Week edition of Agents & Bagels, a curated breakfast for founders and AI builders. The gathering is designed for individuals building production-grade agents and infrastructure to engage in high-signal networking over coffee and bagels.

🔍 Overview

The event focuses on bringing together people working across several specific domains in the AI ecosystem:

  • Agents
  • Developer tools
  • Infrastructure
  • Applied AI

⚙️ Key details

The breakfast gathering is structured to prioritize conversation over formal presentations.

  • Format: No panels, pitches, or long presentations.
  • Catering: Coffee and bagels provided for participants.
  • Access: Attendance is by approval only and invitations are non-transferable.
  • Media: Organizers may capture and distribute photos, videos, and audio recordings for promotional and marketing purposes.

🧩 How it works

The event is held in collaboration with several co-hosts and the Ugly Talk community.

Entity Role
Scalekit Co-host
Nebius Co-host
Tenki Co-host
Ugly Talk Event organizer and community platform

🚀 Availability

Participation is managed through a registration and approval process. Approved guests receive a confirmation email and a calendar invitation. Registration requires agreement to a Code of Conduct and a liability waiver. Attendees also agree to receive marketing communications from Ugly Talk and its partners, with the option to unsubscribe at any time.

💡 Why it matters

This gathering provides a venue for builders to share raw lessons and insights, following a model established by Ugly Talk in 2019 to transform business setbacks into breakthrough moments. It targets those scaling agent workflows and exploring next-generation AI infrastructure, offering a focused environment for peers in the ecosystem to start the day with meaningful conversations.

#SFTechWeek #AIAgents #AIInfrastructure #Startups

Source: UGLY TALK: AGENTS & BAGELS (BREAKFAST MEET UP FOR AGENT BUILDERS)

item.title: a16z Launches Horowitz Andreessen Academy for Silicon Valley Startup Pipeline
item.description:
a16z Launches Horowitz Andreessen Academy for Silicon Valley Startup Pipeline

Venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) is creating the Horowitz Andreessen Academy, a pipeline designed for young people to build or join a Silicon Valley startup.

🔍 Overview

Led by a16z with $42 million in funding, the academy is described as a “highly selective school” that does not grant any accreditation or degree. It is designed mainly for recent high school graduates.

🧩 How it works

The program replaces traditional academic structures with a focus on industry experience:

  • Curriculum: Short, high-impact classes led by tech figureheads, such as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.
  • Practical Experience: “Co-ops” that provide students with roles at tech companies.
  • Assessment: There are no traditional grades, tests, or homework.

⚙️ Key details

Students in the program are provided with specific financial and technical resources:

  • More than $50,000 in compute credits
  • A $5,000 travel and research budget offered by a16z
Partner Role
Anduril Partner
Anthropic Partner
Coinbase Partner
Google Partner
Meta Partner
Nvidia Partner
OpenAI Partner
Palantir Partner
Replit Partner
Stripe Partner

🚀 Availability

  • Launch Date: The first one-year program begins in the fall of 2027.
  • Cost: The first program will be free.
  • Capacity: Only 50 students will be accepted.
  • Requirements: Students must move to San Francisco and arrange their own housing.

💡 Why it matters

The academy follows a trend of Silicon Valley billionaires, including Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, and Jeff Bezos, investing in their own schools. a16z founders Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz have been critical of colleges; Andreessen reportedly called the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Stanford “political lobbying operations fighting American innovation” in a group chat with tech leaders and White House officials.

#a16z #SiliconValley #Education #Startups

Source: Andreessen Horowitz is launching an ‘academy’ with no homework and partnerships with Palantir, Google, and Meta

item.title: Istanbul to Host Inaugural GITEX AI Türkiye 2026 Conference in September
item.description:
Istanbul to Host Inaugural GITEX AI Türkiye 2026 Conference in September

The Investment and Finance Office of the Presidency of Türkiye has announced that Istanbul will host the inaugural GITEX AI Türkiye 2026 conference from September 9-10 at the Istanbul Expo Center. The event aims to establish Istanbul as a regional hub for artificial intelligence innovation by connecting local startups with international investors.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Attendees: Over 300 companies and startups, alongside public representatives and technology executives.
  • Investor Participation: More than 100 global investors from 20 countries managing over $100 billion in assets.
  • Hosting: Hosted by the Investment and Finance Office with a strategic partnership from the Ministry of Industry and Technology.
  • Communication Partner: Anadolu Agency.

💡 Why it Matters

  • The conference serves as a platform to connect emerging artificial intelligence ventures with established tech giants and international funding sources.
  • The program focuses on evaluating innovations in sectors including sustainable agriculture, AI-driven education, enterprise technologies, healthcare, and infrastructure.

🚀 Exhibition Participants

Category Description
Domestic Tech Firms High-growth companies introducing custom-built solutions for corporate needs
Turcorn 100 Program 24 companies showcasing technologies and solutions for global market access
International Ventures High-potential startups scouted by global investment funds

#AI #Türkiye #GITEX #TechInvestment #Startups

Source: GITEX AI Türkiye 2026 to gather global investors
